scope: A comprehensive working register of credible affiliate networks, subnetworks, creator-commerce platforms, CPA networks, and merchant-owned programs relevant to a US consumer-deals publisher. The market is open-ended, so the daily refresh adds credible networks as they are discovered rather than claiming this is every regional or private network worldwide.
publicationRule: A network-level status never authorizes an offer. DealDesk may publish only an approved merchant relationship with an exact payable DealDesk tracking link, a verified live offer, and genuine merchant or product imagery. Unpaid, pending, untracked, unavailable, broken, or visually unverified offers stay hidden.

materialChanges: DealDesk account or site approval change
broken official, signup, dashboard, or evidence URL

statusDefinitions.active_payable: DealDesk has at least one approved, verified payable relationship on this platform; individual offers still require verification.
statusDefinitions.active_no_payable_program: The publisher account is active, but no approved payable merchant relationship is currently available.
statusDefinitions.active_limited: The account exists, but its type or access level blocks the programs DealDesk needs.
statusDefinitions.pending_review: An application or site review is pending.
statusDefinitions.declined: DealDesk's application was declined; no offer may publish through this network unless a later approval is verified.
statusDefinitions.onboarding: An account exists, but required onboarding or program-level verification is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.not_started: No DealDesk application has been submitted.
statusDefinitions.migrating: The platform is being moved into another canonical network and should not receive a new standalone application.
statusDefinitions.closed: The platform has closed and is retained only to resolve old names or links.

payoutReadinessDefinitions.verified: The payout destination and required onboarding are verified complete without storing financial details here.
payoutReadinessDefinitions.unverified: An account or application exists, but payout onboarding has not been verified.
payoutReadinessDefinitions.not_started: No DealDesk account exists, so payout onboarding has not begun.
payoutReadinessDefinitions.not_applicable: The network is closed, declined, or migrating and has no current DealDesk payout path.
payoutReadinessDefinitions.unknown: The program can generate payable links, but payout-setup completion was not reverified in this run.
